settings.title: RED LIGHT THERAPY
settings.text: Employing safe and gentle 630-nanometer red light wavelengths, this non-invasive therapy effectively enhances skin radiance, promoting a glowing complexion. For most healthy individuals, it offers results without downtime or side effects.

settings.title: MICROCURRENT
settings.text: The Microcurrent, a gentle and non-intrusive energy, enhances your skin's absorption of serums and creams, allowing your skincare products to function more effectively and yield improved results.

settings.title: BLUE LIGHT THERAPY
settings.text: Using 415-nanometer blue light, this non-invasive therapy targets acne-causing bacteria, diminishes breakouts by controlling sebum, and usually doesn't involve downtime or side effects for most healthy individuals. It's a natural, pain-free treatment suitable for people of all ages and genders.

settings.title: FACIAL MASSAGE
settings.text: Facial massage stimulates circulation, aids lymphatic drainage, and rejuvenates the skin, fostering a healthy, radiant complexion.

settings.title: THERAPEUTIC WARMTH
settings.text: Therapeutic warmth, a non-invasive treatment, rejuvenates skin by gently applying soothing heat. GLOWXTRA Magic Wands deliver this at 100°F (37.8°C), ensuring safety, comfort, and relaxation while boosting skincare product absorption.

“I'm truly fascinated by the Glow Extra Skincare wand, particularly because of its remarkable red and blue light therapy, renowned for their effectiveness in reducing fine lines and tackling acne issues by eliminating acne-causing bacteria. These sought-after features are commonly found in medical spas, and this skincare wand not only enhances skin hydration, moreover, the therapeutic warmth helps skincare products absorb easily. What I especially adore is the microcurrent technology that imparts a revitalizing effect to the skin, reducing puffiness and enhancing circulation..”
